name: Footwork
description: Tempo-synced Chicago footwork / juke kit. Hold to gate — hits lock to the host beat. Sparse kick spine plus X-driven stutter kicks; Y grows snare rolls and frantic hats. Flick top-right for a one-bar Fill. Default feel ~160 BPM.

params.name: STUT
params.detail: Kick stutter density between spine hits
